name: Myeloid phagocyte activation and respiratory burst control
rationale: Members cover inflammatory activation of neutrophils, monocytes and macrophages (TLR, complement receptor, degranulation) with positive and negative regulation of NADPH-oxidase respiratory burst and superoxide generation, which the neutrophil killing, degranulation and formyl-peptide chemotaxis confusables lack.

name: Axon guidance by netrin, ephrin and L1-family receptors
rationale: All members are growth-cone guidance and fasciculation signals (netrin/DCC, EPH-ephrin repulsion, L1/CHL1, DSCAM, RAC1), distinguished from SLIT-ROBO commissural and repulsion-only confusables by the netrin, ephrin and L1-family adhesion receptor content.

name: Proximal B cell antigen receptor signaling
rationale: Members describe antigen-triggered BCR signaling to second messengers, BTK and RAS plus a module tuning antigen-receptor activation thresholds, unlike confusables on B cell differentiation/proliferation or Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis.

qualifier: Tfh help via ICOS and CD27
name: Germinal center Tfh help and B cell memory
rationale: Members span germinal center formation, Tfh differentiation, ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation, memory B/T cell responses and B cell homeostasis signatures, setting it apart from confusables on B cell development, proliferation and plasma cells.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal control of systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members concern systemic arterial pressure and blood volume via angiotensin generation and signaling, renal sodium/urine/glomerular control, natriuretic cGMP and kinin catabolism, distinct from nitric oxide/smooth muscle and vasopressin-aquaporin water confusables.

name: Post-embryonic eye development and vascular regression apoptosis
rationale: Two members are post-embryonic eye development and one is apoptosis in blood vessel remodeling (as in ocular vessel regression); the post-embryonic stage separates it from embryonic eye, lens and vasculogenesis confusables.

name: PDGF receptor signaling in fibroblast and stromal activation
rationale: Members centre on regulation of PDGFR-alpha/beta signaling and its endocytic control together with fibroblast proliferation and mechanoresponsive stromal programmes, which the TGF-beta, ECM-secretory and Hippo/YAP confusables lack.

name: Inner and middle ear morphogenesis with vestibular function
rationale: Members cover otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, otolith and middle ear morphogenesis, hair cell fate and vestibulocochlear nerve plus vestibular reflex and gravity response, distinguishing it from broader craniofacial sensory and hearing-physiology confusables.

name: Mitotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromere assembly
rationale: Members are prophase/prometaphase and meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres, setting it apart from cytokinesis, cohesion and spindle confusables.

core: Glycolipid and GPI-anchor biosynthesis and transport
name: Glycolipid and GPI anchor biosynthesis, spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members cover synthesis and transport of glycosphingolipids and GPI anchors plus hereditary spastic paraplegia lipid-enzyme defects, distinct from nucleotide-sugar transport, protein palmitoylation and lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism confusables.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
name: Nuclear pore transport and SUMO conjugation
rationale: Members combine nuclear pore assembly and nucleocytoplasmic transport (proteins, ribosomal subunits, inositol phosphates, HIV Rev) with the SUMO processing, conjugation and desumoylation cycle, which separates it from nuclear envelope, mRNA export and chromatin-SUMOylation confusables.

name: Dolichyl phosphate biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of dolichol/dolichyl phosphate for lipid-linked oligosaccharides (including DHDDS deficiency), upstream of the sugar-donor and CDG confusables.

name: Double-strand break repair, ADP-ribosylation and BRCA defects
rationale: Members span break sensing, resection, HR, NHEJ, SSA and MMEJ pathway regulation, PARP ADP-ribosylation and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function variants, which the replication-fork, recombination-intermediate and telomere confusables lack.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation, NF-kB arm
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling regulation and NF-kB activation
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA sensing with its positive and negative regulators and the TRAF6/FADD NF-kB branch, unlike confusables centred on IRF3/7-driven type I interferon production and ISG15.

name: G1/S restriction control by cyclin-CDKs and RB1
rationale: Members concern cyclin D-CDK4/6 and cyclin E-CDK2 activity, CKI and cyclin D degradation, RB1-E2F binding defects and the G1/S checkpoint, unlike G2/M and E2F-transcription confusables.

core: IL-10 family and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
name: IL-10 family, type III interferon and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20 subfamily and type III interferon (lambda) signaling plus IL-12/IL-23 signaling, distinguished from IL-27/IL-35, IL-15/IL-21 and IFN-gamma confusables by the type III interferon and IL-20 content.

name: Endothelial stabilization via Tie2, restraining VEGF-driven sprouting
rationale: Members cover Tie2 and VEGFR2 signaling, negative regulation of VEGF responses and sprouting, endothelial survival and adherens junction control, separating it from pro-angiogenic VEGF and integrin/Rac adhesion confusables.

name: APOBEC cytidine deamination in RNA editing and antiviral restriction
rationale: Members cover C-to-U editosome RNA editing, DNA cytosine deamination, APOBEC3G restriction of viral replication and its Vif-mediated degradation, distinct from DNA demethylation, viral replication and AID somatic hypermutation confusables.

name: Neutrophil chemotaxis via formyl peptide receptors and degranulation
rationale: Members cover neutrophil recruitment and chemotaxis regulation, formyl peptide receptor signaling, degranulation and complement/TLR inflammatory signaling, separating it from chemokine-production, phagocytosis, respiratory-burst and extravasation confusables.

name: MAPK negative feedback, ERK dephosphorylation and atypical MAPKs
rationale: Members concern ERK inactivation by dephosphorylation and negative feedback, serine/threonine phosphorylation control and ERK5/MAPK4/6 cascades, unlike confusables on RAS-RAF activation, AP-1/IL-6 or JNK/p38.

name: CHD-family ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members are CHD/SNF2 remodelers (CHD1/2, CHD6-9, NuRD, ChAHP, CSB) with one outlier hatching term, distinguishing it from BAF complex and histone-methylation confusables.

core: Germ cell and early embryo program
qualifier: sperm function, fertilization, zygotic activation, piRNA silencing
name: Sperm function, fertilization, zygotic activation and transposon silencing
rationale: Members span spermiogenesis and sperm function, fertilization, maternal-to-zygotic transition and germline piRNA/KRAB/HUSH retroelement silencing and imprinting, distinct from gonad-hormone and meiotic recombination confusables.

name: Epidermal basement membrane, hemidesmosome and cornified envelope assembly
rationale: Members cover laminin-integrin basement membrane interactions, anchoring fibrils, hemidesmosomes and transglutaminase cross-linking of the cornified envelope, setting it apart from collagen/elastic fibre and desmosome/cell-cell adhesion confusables.

name: Tight junction regulation of endothelial and epithelial barriers
rationale: Members concern assembly, disassembly and localization of tight junction components and endothelial/intestinal/blood-brain barrier permeability (including adrenomedullin), distinct from adherens junction and shear stress confusables.

qualifier: SASP and Polycomb cell cycle silencing
name: Oncogene-induced senescence, SASP and Polycomb cell cycle silencing
rationale: Members cover promotion of senescence, oncogene-induced arrest, the SASP and Polycomb/AP-2 control of cell cycle genes, distinguishing it from stress-induced, replicative and SAHF-heterochromatin senescence confusables.
